scope: Interim bounded read-only authority/runtime and task-owned C-cache exploration, before source freeze
acceptanceReason: Final runtime source and tests are not frozen; this is an exploration, not a source permit.
positiveFindings: Runtime stages inventory clone; preserves the physical UID and full bind/soul-bound/shop/GM provenance for one-to-one template reclassification; no fresh UserItem issuance.

Runtime commits the staged raw/output carrier, gold and next global registry under a single fixed account/serial transaction, checking registry equality and durable character revision plus NPC actor incarnation.

PostgreSQL registry singleton FOR UPDATE/CAS and account writes occur inside the same transaction; network-unknown stone commit classifies as shared write freeze. File uncertain rename/directory-sync outcome reuses the shared File authority freeze.

Public views expose grade/table/fees/possibilities and only coarse appraisal clue; ItemState carries serial reference only, not hidden outcome or seed; normal UserItem conversion excludes the server registry.

Exact registry request replay is owner account plus persisted character incarnation, evaluated before current possession and gold. Transfers use current possession holder rather than retaining mint owner as permanent authorization.
Outgoing packet carrier conversion has been moved before commit in the latest runtime source.
pendingRootFixes: refresh_sealed_stone_authority method was absent in the observed config read and is already being implemented by Root.
Repository stone version receipt checks and FullRestore preservation of locked repository stone version are already scheduled Root fixes; not accepted as complete.
runtime/stones_tests.rs was absent during the bounded reads while runtime uses cfg(test) include; a final permit must bind the actual authored tests.

integrationLimits.finding: NPC handler requires current view and current command before runtime exact replay. After successful inventory/revision change, an old action fails the current gate or no longer appears in the active links. Runtime direct replay proof is not an actual NPC original-receipt recovery route.
integrationLimits.recommendation: Keep original link authentication and reject new stale actions; add a separately authenticated read-only original operation query/reconciliation seam if actual NPC replay/recovery is claimed.

integrationLimits.finding: Global registry caps 1024 records and retains all spent history; archival is not implemented.
integrationLimits.recommendation: Retain the fail-closed limit in focused testing; public sustained use requires durable partition/archive plus irreversible spent and receipt preservation.

integrationLimits.finding: Default all-issuer UID authority/census and private outcome lifecycle across unsupported custody routes remain outside this reclassification proof.
integrationLimits.recommendation: Do not claim global UID rollout, all shared/PG custody, public gateway/UI or installer acceptance. Ordinary full ItemState custody preserves serial, but ground UserItem-only payload must be tested or blocked for stone carriers.
